sentences.japanese: 恐縮ですが、９時にここへおいで頂けますか。
sentences.english: Will you kindly come here at nine?

sentences.japanese: あなたが一度約束した事は実行して頂きたい。
sentences.english: We expect you to carry out what you have once promised.

sentences.japanese: 何か冷たいものを頂けませんか。
sentences.english: Would you give me something cold to drink?

sentences.japanese: 何か食べ物を頂けますか。
sentences.english: Can I have something to eat?

sentences.japanese: お願いを聞いて頂けませんか。
sentences.english: May I ask a favor of you?
